summary_1line: Narada recounts the mighty deeds and vast sacrifices of Bharata and begins describing the miraculous reign of King Prithu.

image_candidates.scene_text: The child Bharata drags a roaring lion by the neck through the forest while astonished ascetics watch.
At a grand sacrifice, gods and Brahmanas gather as a massive golden sacrificial stake is raised for King Bharata.
King Prithu stands with bow in hand addressing the Earth, who appears before him as beings prepare to milk her for bounty.
